segments.name: Semiconductors and modules
segments.description: Designs, develops, manufactures and markets high-performance RF and optical semiconductor products for Industrial and Defense, Data Center and Telecom customers.
segments.evidence: We have one reportable operating segment that designs, develops, manufactures and markets semiconductors and modules.

revenueModel.text: Customers buy high-performance RF, microwave, millimeter wave, optical and photonic semiconductor products, sold direct, through independent representatives and through distributors.
revenueModel.evidence: We design, integrate, manufacture and package differentiated, semiconductor-based products that we sell to customers through our direct sales organization, our network of independent sales representatives and our distributors.
